This page covers Compliance, Audit & Digital Trust the way we deliver it: the pattern, the stack it runs on, the guards we ship and the artifacts your team holds at the first quarter close.

blocks.title: Zero-trust verification mesh — Compliance, Audit & Digital Trust
blocks.note: Lateral movement dies here: workload identity and micro-segmentation mean one compromised node is one node, not the estate.

blocks.x: We engineer Compliance, Audit & Digital Trust so that regressions are cohorts, not surprises: each stage owns its latency budget and failure policy, and rollback is rehearsed before go-live rather than after the incident.

The build sequence is deliberate: contracts and identity first, the working decision slice second, the verification harness third — because a Compliance, Audit & Digital Trust capability without its eval gate is just another unattended automation.
